facts.text: The pre-licensure Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) program operates year-round across fall, spring, and summer terms, allowing students to complete their degree in as few as 32 months.

sources.title: BSN Degree | Online Nursing Program (CCNE-Accredited) - Nightingale College
sources.quote: With eight semesters delivered across fall, spring, and summer semesters, qualified learners can earn their BSN in as few as 32 months.
